description: Schema v1 of the decisions stream.

attempt_lanes.description: lane of each model attempt, in order

batch_action.description: S705 operation_action prefix of the route's one batched commit (the push freeze's typed exception)

behind_ref.description: S705 what a refused operation waits behind (pr:N, DECISION, WIP_LIMIT, a held subject)

branch.description: S693 branch of the pilot namespace (agent/<work-item>-<slug>)

cause_class.description: typed class of the source cause text

chain_step.description: S692 typed newest step of an ended chain (JOURNAL_FAILED_RECORDED, ...)

check_states.description: S693 check runs per state on the original head of a pure carry (opened without the local validation gate) (unit: checks)

clear_basis.description: S705 the refusal predicate's basis: why it no longer applies (RULE_CHANGED, INPUTS_CHANGED, OPERATOR_NAMED, RETRY_DUE, PULL_CLOSED, WIP_ADMITTED, HOLD_RELEASED), or for REFUSAL_SEQUENCED why it still does (PULL_OPEN, ...)

confidence.description: S694 confidence of a disposition record or architecture check (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)

contenders.description: S692 ready Work Items when the grant was decided

context_last_request.description: context tokens of the lane last request at the gate (unit: tokens)

context_median.description: median context tokens per call of the lane at the gate (unit: tokens)

decision_basis.description: S701 how the decision reference verified: OWNER (the Owner's comment) or SUPERVISOR_RELAY (an operator-named relay record)

decision_reason.description: S701 why a decision reference did not verify (decision_authority.REASONS)

decision_source.description: S701 the operator data that names the decision reference (CONFIG, OPERATOR, COMMAND, POLICY)

derived.description: computed from other records; replaced on recomputation

draft.description: S693 the opened pull request read back as a draft

effect.description: S701 effect of a remedy operation (OPEN, CLOSE, RECORD)

effort.description: reasoning effort of the lane or turn (low, medium, high)

end_class.description: S692 class of a chain end (INFRASTRUCTURE, MODEL_CAPACITY, DECISION)

entity.description: key of a mutable entity: keep the latest version (by ts, then record_id)

error_class.description: typed class of an error (code, exception name or TEXT_<digest>)

existing_pr.description: S701 the pull request an admitted open reconciles (the carrier already open)

first_lane.description: lane key the routing decision chose

freeze_release.description: S705 how a push freeze ended (BATCH_PUBLISHED, ROUTER_RELEASE, SUBJECT_CLOSED, EXPIRED)

frozen_head.description: S705 head a push freeze holds (a FREEZE_VIOLATION observed another one)

granted_item.description: S705 the Work Item granted instead of a skipped non-runnable contender (none: no runnable contender)

held_s.description: S692 time a slot grant was held before it ended (unit: s)

idle_s.description: S692 time an ACTIVE obligation had no live next step when its chain end was found (unit: s)

last_failure_cause.description: cause of the last failed attempt

launch_cause.description: typed sub-cause of a PROCESS_LAUNCH (S691 launch_guard.LAUNCH_CAUSES)

limit_kind.description: kind of provider limit (QUOTA, DAILY_CAP, OVERLOAD)

link.description: S701 the Work Item link of a typed close (PRESENT, POSTED, UNCONFIRMED, FAILED)

measures.description: typed numeric or code facts of the source row

model.description: model id the turn ran on (requested model)

over_item.description: S692 Work Item whose consecutive operations triggered a FAIRNESS_RUN grant

passed.description: S692 operations of other Work Items while the granted item waited

plan_switch.description: the gate planned a family switch

prelaunch.description: S701 the refusal was known before the turn: no model ran

priority.description: S692 aged priority of the granted item (weight x (1 + wait / aging))

profile.description: CLI credential profile alias of the lane (A, A2, B, C)

publication_mode.description: S693 open mode (WORK_ITEM: an admitted Work Item from main; CARRIER: an Owner-decided carrier)

reason.description: typed reason (class of the source reason)

recommendation.description: S694 recommendation of a disposition record (CARRY_OVER, RE_IMPLEMENT, CLOSE_SUPERSEDED)

record_id.description: stable id: sha256 of the source pointer and the normalized content, or of an explicit identity for observations, snapshots and derived rows

refusal_code.description: S705 typed code of the refusal whose predicate cleared (refusal_causes.PREDICATES)

released_brake.description: typed reason of a released brake

remedy.description: S701 registered remedy of the item (CARRIER, RE_IMPLEMENT, CLOSE_SUPERSEDED)

reported_tokens.description: tokens as the role receipt reports them (agy: cumulative for the conversation) (unit: tokens)

request_kind.description: S692 kind of a custody continuation (CHAIN_ENDED_UNDECIDED, SLOT_GRANTED)

retry_reason.description: typed retry reason of a dispatch

review_stage.description: S694 disposition stage of the transition (SAS_RECORD, PAO_ARCH_CHECK, REQUEST)

rotate_before_launch.description: the gate rotated the conversation before launch

routing_floor.description: S694/S698 lane tier a disposition review turn starts from (0 = the base lane)

runnable_basis.description: S705 why a ready Work Item could not use the slot (ASK_BUDGET_SPENT, ASK_UNANSWERED, DECISION_STALE, HELD, NO_NEXT_STEP)

running_item.description: S692 Work Item whose turn ran when the grant was decided

same_body.description: S698 a retried decision request renders the same body as the refused one

source_pr.description: S693 original pull request a carrier carries

stalls.description: stalls counted by the tier rule

status.description: status code of the source record

streak.description: S692 longest run of one other Work Item while the granted item waited

streak_max.description: longest streak the tier rule saw

switch.description: the transport family switched for this turn

switch_reason.description: typed reason of the transport choice

task_class.description: task class of a routing decision

terminal_failure.description: the job ended as a terminal failure

tier_reason.description: why the tier was chosen (BASE, ESCALATE_AFTER_STALL, ...)

to_state.description: S692 obligation state after a transition (ACTIVE, WAITING, PARKED, DONE)

tool_reads.description: S698 provider reads the disposition turn prompt allows (0 = answer with no tool call)

transport.description: transport of the turn (agy, claude-print, codex-exec, *-resume)

ts.description: UTC time of the fact; the partition day

ts_basis.description: set when ts is not the record time itself

units.description: unit of every field of the record that has one

unlaunched_retries.description: failed turns that did no model work and spent no model attempt (S691)

wait_s.description: S692 time a Work Item has waited ready for the Implementer slot (unit: s)

title: decisions
